Primary request: understated, believable editorial photograph of an unoccupied software development workstation, no people.

Neatly routed practical cables, ordinary keyboard, natural slight wear in desk surface. No extra decorative gadgets. Side-on three-quarter camera view, screens and desk concentrated in the middle horizontal band, soft office background.
Lighting: soft window daylight from off frame, balanced natural colors, subtle shadows, documentary architecture photography, 35mm lens, realistic glass reflections, authentic materials and mild texture. Professional and calm with imperfect everyday details.

Screens secondary to the physical environment, tiny unreadable interface labels only. Avoid holograms, glowing circuit boards, floating UI, excessive neon, science-fiction, glossy CGI, surreal geometry or artificial over-polishing.
